name: Jade Ornament (Magatama Pendant Detail)
description: Exquisite 3D showcase of an imperial jade magatama amulet. Translucent deep emerald-green carved comma-shaped jade talisman with gold filigree dragon inlay, suspended by an intricate braided crimson red silk tassel with polished obsidian beads.
prompt: Masterwork 3D detailed concept art of a sacred Japanese jade magatama pendant talisman. A curved translucent emerald green jade magatama with intricate gold filigree dragon inlay, suspended by a thick braided crimson red (#FF2035) silk cord tassel with polished black beads, resting on dark ebony wood. Pure pitch-black background (#000000), internal jade luminescence and vivid crimson rim lighting, 8k render, no text.
